🇫🇷 🇺🇦 A political scandal is brewing in France over the deployment of French military personnel to Ukraine without notifying the parliament, writes Politico. Today, Alice Rufo, the Deputy Minister of Defense of France, has been summoned to closed hearings in the Senate, where she is expected to explain the circumstances of the deployment of military personnel. Last week, the French radio station RFI reported that the military personnel are in Ukraine as part of the Volia mission, led by a French general. They are engaged in training Ukrainian military personnel and maintaining the military equipment transferred by Paris. The opposition accuses the government of violating the constitution and creating a risk of direct French involvement in the war with Russia. According to Article 35 of the French constitution, the government is required to notify parliament of the deployment of troops for intervention in a conflict abroad within three days. If the operation lasts more than four months, its continuation must be approved by parliament. However, the French Ministry of Defense claims that this provision does not apply to missions that do not involve participation in combat operations. The opposition disagrees with this. “If these military personnel become involved in combat operations, France will be at war with Russia without a single vote in parliament,” stated Bastien Lachaud, a member of parliament from the “Unbowed France” party. Cedric Perrin, head of the Senate committee on defense, accused Macron of disrespecting parliament. “We cannot accuse Putin of lying while simultaneously hiding information that damages our cause,” the senator stated. The publication notes that two key candidates for the presidential post in France - Le Pen and Mélenchon - are negatively disposed toward aid to Ukraine and demand preventing a war with Russia. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an assault brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade close to Vasilevka, Maleyevka, Monachinovka, Nechvolodovka, Osadkovka, Smorodkovka (Kharkov region), and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 210 troops, one tank, one armoured fighting vehicle, five motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun. 📍 The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. Russian troops hit formations of a mountain assault brigade of the AFU near Kamyshevakha and Kirovo of Zaporozhye region. ▪️ Up to 15 troops and five motor vehicles of the enemy were neutralised. ✈️ Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation inflicted damage on power and transport infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU, production, storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles and ground robotic systems, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations, and foreign mercenaries in 149 areas. ▫️ Air defence systems shot down 863 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles. 📊 In total, since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost: ▫️ 674 aircraft, ▫️ 284 helicopters, ▫️ 298,013 unmanned aerial vehicles, ▫️ 672 anti-aircraft missile systems, ▫️ 31,771 tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles, ▫️ 1,797 MLRS combat vehicles, ▫️ 36,986 field artillery guns and mortars, ▫️ 78,013 special military vehicles. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

СВОД на всем фронте В «Коммерсанте» вышло интервью замминистра обороны Дмитрия Щербинина, где он рассказал, что система СВОД, которую ранее обкатывали в группировке «Центр», заработала во всех шести группировках войск. Что такое СВОД? По сути, это закрытая экосистема, где бойцы из специального магазина загружают нужные приложения — что-то вроде военного аналога Google Play или App Store для служебных мобильных и стационарных устройств. Система сводит данные со всех средств обнаружения на единую карту (воздушная, инженерная, радиоэлектронная обстановка) и позволяет соседним подразделениям обмениваться целеуказаниями напрямую. Автоматически данные идут и наверх. Сервис допиливают как живой гражданский продукт. Бойцы прямо с мест пишут в чаты и боты, что сбоит и какие функции нужны, а разработчики оперативно выкатывают обновления для всех. Отдельный вызов — кибербезопасность. Нейросети противника уже находят уязвимости за минуты, хотя раньше на это уходили месяцы. В Минобороны отвечают своим ИИ — его внедряют в управление войсками, техникой и повседневную работу. Так в Минобороны заработала локальная нейронка для документов — ею пользуются более 1400 человек: ИИ-агенты сводят таблицы, делают выжимки и готовят проекты документов. Параллельно выстраивают «цифровую вертикаль» и Единую информационную среду (более 15 направлений — от гособоронзаказа и МТО до медицины и соцподдержки), чтобы ускорить оформление льгот и убрать бумажные справки. @DKulko
